premises.text: Restaurants price the same despite peak/off-peak demand, wasting perishable table inventory and high fixed-cost capacity
premises.evidence_span: you end up paying the exact same price for your meal at both those occasions. Well, this doesn't make economic sense, at least not for a perishable inventory

premises.text: About 40% of restaurant inventory is underutilized from lack of yield management, contributing to high failure rates
premises.evidence_span: about 40% of the restaurant inventory is underutilized due to lack of revenue or yield management

premises.text: ResGuru automatically changes restaurant prices based on demand and supply as a GDS-like platform
premises.evidence_span: a dynamic pricing platform for restaurants. It allows the restaurants to automatically change their prices based on demand and supply

premises.text: Platform consolidates reservations and orders across online/offline channels with POS integration and analytics
premises.evidence_span: all my reservations, all my food orders are consolidated from across all the online and offline channels for my restaurant

premises.text: Dynamic pricing uses menu engineering, utilization/overbooking rules, and channel commissions
premises.evidence_span: we can actually do menu engineering. We can set up a strategy to start off with

premises.text: Forecasting uses many macro/micro variables and historical trends to price each time slot
premises.evidence_span: taking into account 21 different variables, macro and micro data points, and along with historical trends to forecast the demand

premises.text: Better pricing also reduces food waste from poor forecasting and suboptimal selling
premises.evidence_span: wasted because restaurants, A, are not able to forecast properly, B, they are not able to price their product optimally to sell it at the right point

value.text: Restaurants optimize revenue and utilization via demand-based pricing
value.evidence_span: help them optimize their revenue, but also get you better deals in your restaurants

secondary_value.text: Diners get better deals at off-peak times
secondary_value.evidence_span: get you better deals in your restaurants

causal_links.evidence_span: forecast the demand for me and give me a pricing strategy for each time slot during the day
